description: This file contains a test runner class and related functions for executing layout tests in the WebKit project, including handling test results, rebaselining, and error conditions.

classes.name: SingleTestRunner
classes.description: A class responsible for executing individual layout tests, handling different test modes (compare, rebaseline, reftest, sanitized), managing baselines, and error handling.

methods.name: run_single_test
methods.description: Function to instantiate and run a SingleTestRunner for a given test.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing the SingleTestRunner with test parameters and environment.

methods.name: _expected_driver_output
methods.description: Returns the expected output for the test, including text, image, checksum, and audio.

methods.name: _should_fetch_expected_checksum
methods.description: Determines if the checksum should be fetched based on options.

methods.name: _driver_input
methods.description: Prepares the DriverInput object for running the test.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main method to execute the test based on current options and state.

methods.name: _run_sanitized_test
methods.description: Runs a sanitized test, focusing on crashes and timeouts.

methods.name: _run_compare_test
methods.description: Runs a comparison test, checking actual vs expected results.

methods.name: _run_rebaseline
methods.description: Re-runs the test to update baselines with current output.

methods.name: _add_missing_baselines
methods.description: Adds missing baseline files if test failures indicate their absence.

methods.name: _location_for_new_baseline
methods.description: Determines where to save new baseline data based on options and data content.

methods.name: _overwrite_baselines
methods.description: Overwrites existing baselines with current test output.

methods.name: _save_baseline_data
methods.description: Saves baseline data to the specified location.

methods.name: _handle_error
methods.description: Analyzes driver output for errors like crashes, timeouts, leaks, and logs failures.

methods.name: _compare_output
methods.description: Compares expected and actual driver outputs, generating failures for mismatches.

methods.name: _compare_testharness_test
methods.description: Checks if the output is a testharness test and its pass/fail status.

methods.name: _is_render_tree
methods.description: Detects if the output text represents a render tree.

methods.name: _compare_text
methods.description: Compares expected and actual text outputs, normalizing line endings.

methods.name: _compare_audio
methods.description: Compares expected and actual audio outputs.

methods.name: _get_normalized_output_text
methods.description: Normalizes line endings in output text for comparison.

methods.name: _compare_image
methods.description: Compares expected and actual images, including diffing if hashes differ.

methods.name: _run_reftest
methods.description: Executes a reftest, comparing test output against multiple references.

methods.name: _compare_output_with_reference
methods.description: Compares driver output against a reference, handling mismatches and errors.
